notablePrerequisites:
You control two additional creatures excluding the creature that has One with the Kami attached to it, at least one of which must be modified.
The top card of your library is a nonland card.
description:
Activate Tooth and Claw by sacrificing two other creatures.
When the creatures die, One with the Kami triggers for each modified creature that died this way, creating a number of 1/1 Spirit creature tokens.
When the Spirit token(s) enter, Captain Kathryn Janeway triggers that many times, revealing the top card of your library, putting the card back on top of your library, and then putting a +1/+1 counter on each Spirit.
Resolve the Tooth and Claw ability, creating a 3/1 Carnivore creature token.
When the Carnivore token enters, Captain Kathryn Janeway triggers, revealing the top card of your library, putting the card back on top of your library, and then putting a +1/+1 counter on the Carnivore token
Repeat.

uses.name: One with the Kami
uses.cardState: attached to any creature you control
